gloss: to enrich (soil); to fatten (livestock); to line one's own pockets

definitions.explanation: To add nutrients to soil so that crops grow well. Used in agricultural contexts.
To raise the body weight of an animal, especially livestock, by feeding it well.

definitions.gloss: to line one's pockets; to enrich oneself (figurative)
definitions.explanation: Used in the idiom {私腹|しふく}を{肥|こ}やす to mean enriching oneself unfairly, usually through one's official position.

notes:
Transitive godan verb (⟦{五段|ごだん}→五段：28275_godan⟧, す-stem). Causative form of ⟦{肥|こ}える→肥える：18770_koeru⟧ (to grow fat; for soil to become rich). The intransitive pair is ⟦{肥|こ}える→肥える：18770_koeru⟧.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive: ⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧/⟦{家畜|かちく}→家畜：06431_kachiku⟧/{私腹|しふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{肥|こ}やす
- Intransitive pair: ⟦{肥|こ}える→肥える：18770_koeru⟧ (to become rich/fat on its own)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{肥|こ}やす: to enrich the soil
- ⟦{家畜|かちく}→家畜：06431_kachiku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{肥|こ}やす: to fatten livestock
- {私腹|しふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{肥|こ}やす: to line one's own pockets (idiom, sense 3)
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{肥|こ}やす: to develop a discerning eye (figurative — gain experience by seeing many examples)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {私腹|しふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{肥|こ}やす: literally "fatten one's private belly" — to abuse a position for personal gain.
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{肥|こ}やす: to refine one's eye through experience.
